summary: Connects to an Orbbec camera and retrieves available video streams such as color, depth, IR, and point cloud data, with Orbbec Select TOPs used for additional streams from the same primary camera.

key_params.name: devicesource
key_params.note: Auto-detect device or connect by IP address.

key_params.name: ip
key_params.note: Camera IP address when using IP source.

key_params.name: depthalignmode
key_params.note: Depth/color alignment mode: disabled, hardware, or software.

key_params.name: image
key_params.note: Primary image stream: color, depth, ir, or pointcloud.

common_gotchas: Only one Orbbec TOP can connect to a camera; use Orbbec Select TOPs for additional streams.
This node uses Orbbec SDK v1, so newer SDK v2-only models may not be supported.
On macOS, connecting to Orbbec cameras requires root privileges.
Newly plugged cameras can take up to 30 seconds to appear in the device menu.
Do not mix Kinect Azure nodes and Orbbec TOP for the same Orbbec hardware in one project.
Property CHOP channel names must be lowercase and omit the OB_PROP_ prefix.
key_concepts: Connects to an Orbbec camera over USB or ethernet depending on the model.
Retrieves camera streams such as color, depth, infrared, and point cloud data.
Only one Orbbec TOP controls a camera; Orbbec Select TOPs retrieve additional streams.
Can expose IMU and property data through gyro, accel, and property CHOP outputs.
